card.name: Risk wording in contraceptive label warnings
card.fires_on: Linking words, commas and number pieces inside combined hormonal contraceptive warnings, right before a list of risks such as venous thromboembolism, heart attack or liver disease.

modes.label: Linking word before a risk
modes.description: A small word like for, of or including that comes right before a named clotting or heart risk.
modes.example: women with a BMI ≥ 30 kg/m 2 had reduced effectiveness and may have a higher risk<< for>> venous thromboembolism events

modes.label: Punctuation or numbering in warning lists
modes.description: A comma, bracket or section number within lists of contraindications and warnings.
modes.example: Current diagnosis of, or history of<<,>> breast cancer, which may be hormone-sensitive

card.plain: It marks spots in birth control warning text where a list of risks such as clots or liver problems is about to follow.
